Panel Recommends Continued OTT Ban on Diljit Dosanjh Film 'Satluj'

A central government panel has recommended continuing the ban on the Over-The-Top (OTT) release of the film 'Satluj', starring Diljit Dosanjh. The panel cited concerns related to national security, sovereignty, and integrity as reasons for its recommendation. The film was previously taken down from streaming platforms.
